title: anethum foeniculum var. dulce
intro: Anethum foeniculum var. dulce, commonly known as sweet fennel, is a variation of the fennel plant, characterized by its sweet anise-like flavor and aroma. The health benefits of sweet fennel include its ability to alleviate digestive issues, such as bloating and gas, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. Therapeutically, sweet fennel is used to calm the stomach, relieve colic and flatulence, and soothe coughs and colds due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of sweet fennel include anethole, a compound responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its therapeutic actions.
